verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents official REST APIs (SQL API, resource-management API) built on OpenAPI specs, and maintains a dedicated 'Behavior change announcements' page describing dated bundles of changes meant to minimize disruption — functioning as a de facto deprecation/change policy. However, there's no explicit documentation of API version numbers (v1/v2) or formal deprecation timelines/sunset dates for the APIs themselves. Missing for 10: explicit API versioning scheme documentation, formal deprecation timeline/sunset policy tied to specific API versions, independent corroboration of API stability guarantees.
